data: You send dark energy at a creature in range, reducing their will to fight. The target must make a {save}. On a failure, it must move to the bottom of the initiative order for this round only. Targets that have already taken their turn in this round are unaffected.
Causes the user to move earlier on the next turn.
Pokemon goes first on the next turn. In the event two similar moves are used in the same turn, the last to use the move goes first. The first to use the move in this case would go second.
